name: Chase Sapphire Preferred Card

tripDelay.notes: Triggers at 12 hours (vs 6 hours for Sapphire Reserve). Covers cardholder and family.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100/day for up to 5 days.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services provides referrals for medical/legal services. Does NOT cover evacuation costs or medical treatment — cardholder is responsible for costs of services obtained.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary coverage (not primary like Sapphire Reserve). Covers rental vehicles with MSRP of $125,000 or less.

hotelCredit.notes: $50 annual Ultimate Rewards hotel credit for hotel stays booked through Chase Travel.

otherCredits.name: Annual Travel Credit
otherCredits.notes: $50 statement credit for hotel purchases made through Chase Travel each account anniversary year.

rewards.travelRate: 5x on travel booked through Chase Travel; 2x on all other travel

travelPerks: $50 annual hotel credit through Chase Travel
Secondary rental car insurance up to $60,000
Baggage delay coverage ($100/day, up to 5 days)
3x points on dining, streaming, and online groceries
1:1 point transfer to 14+ airline and hotel partners
Points worth 25% more when redeemed through Chase Travel
bestFor: Travelers who want strong trip insurance protections and flexible point transfers at a low annual fee
